headline: Melpadam Chundan wins President’s Trophy in photo finish
hook: A razor‑thin margin decided Kerala’s biggest boat race.
what: Melpadam Chundan completed the President’s Trophy race in 3 minutes 42.476 seconds, just ahead of Punnyalan Niranam Chundan from Kumarakom Town Boat Club, which recorded 3 minutes 42.748 seconds. The victory also handed the Champions Boat League title to Melpadam.
why: The close finish showcases the thrill of Kerala’s traditional boat festivals, encouraging youngsters to support or get involved in local sports. Keep an eye on upcoming races for more action.

headline: DRI confiscates nearly 3 kg foreign gold, arrests two
hook: Got gold? The crackdown just hit a big stash.
what: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence recovered 2.98 kilograms of gold that came from abroad, valued at about ₹3.83 crore. The seizure was made during an operation, and two suspects were taken into custody.
why: It shows strict action against illegal gold smuggling, which can influence market prices and taxes. Make sure you buy gold only from legal sources.

headline: Alaska governor-elect edited Wikipedia over 13,000 times
hook: A future leader’s secret hobby is massive Wikipedia editing.
what: Jonathan Kreiss‑Tomkins, who will become Alaska’s governor, has contributed more than 13,000 edits to Wikipedia. The edits span a range of topics.
why: It shows how digital participation can shape a public profile. Teens can learn the impact of responsible online contributions.

headline: Kaviya Maran Sends Gold Rings and Chocolates to Staff
hook: She’s sharing her wedding joy with the whole Sun Group team.
what: After marrying singer Anirudh Ravichander in Greece, Kaviya Maran presented gold rings, chocolates and wedding invitations to Sun Group employees. The gesture was shown in a video that went viral.
why: It shows how Indian companies celebrate personal milestones, encouraging a close‑knit workplace culture. Young workers can see such gestures as a sign of employee appreciation.

headline: Two senior ministers back Kerala CM Satheesan
hook: Cabinet unity confirmed as top leaders reject dissent rumors
what: Kerala ministers Muraleedharan and Sudhakaran said they stand with Chief Minister P. Satheesan. They called reports of internal conflict false and affirmed that the government will finish its full term.
why: A stable state government influences policies on education, jobs and services that affect young people. Keep watching Kerala’s decisions that shape your future.

headline: New‑Age Tech Stocks Lag While Paytm Drops 10.8%
hook: Tech rally passes by, and Paytm takes a hit.
what: Most new‑age technology shares failed to join this week’s broader market surge. Out of 69 listed, just 22 moved with the rally. Paytm’s stock fell about 10.8%.
why: Young investors should note the uneven performance and think about diversifying. Keep an eye on market trends before betting on any single stock.

headline: Kochi Police Officer Suspended After Parking Row Incident
hook: A police ASI was put on hold after allegedly slapping a driver.
what: An Assistant Sub‑Inspector from the Kalamassery AR camp was suspended. He is accused of slapping a driver from North Paravur during a parking dispute at Nilakkal while on Sabarimala duty.
why: The case raises concerns about police conduct during the pilgrim season. Young people should know their rights if they face misuse of authority.

headline: Manipur hooch tragedy claims 16 lives, six arrested
hook: A deadly illicit liquor raid hits a remote Naga village.
what: The death count from the illegal liquor incident in Manipur rose to 16. Authorities have taken six people into custody, and most of those who died came from Nungpan village, where the Anal Naga community is predominant.
why: The incident shows the danger of unregulated alcohol, especially in remote areas. Teens should avoid illicit drinks and report any suspicious activity.

headline: GST agency raids sites over ₹1 lakh crore China-linked gaming deals
hook: Huge gaming money trail under probe, raids hit two cities
what: The Directorate General of GST Intelligence carried out searches in Vijayawada and Hyderabad’s Banjara Hills. The raids are part of a probe into gaming transactions worth about ₹1 lakh crore that are linked to China.
why: Such a massive flow of money could affect the gaming market and tax policies, so gamers should stay aware of any regulatory changes.

headline: Gujarat trader gets fresh review in ₹7.6 lakh PAN mix-up
hook: Two PAN numbers sparked a big tax reassessment.
what: A trader from Gujarat was found to have two PAN numbers because of a clerical mistake. The tax department is now reassessing a ₹7.60 lakh liability after the ITAT ordered a fresh look.
why: It shows that errors in tax IDs can lead to hefty disputes, so youngsters should ensure their PAN details are correct and keep records tidy.

headline: Chittoor farmers advised to add natural farming, dairy, horticulture
hook: New push to widen farm income could change rural earnings.
what: Agricultural officials in Chittoor are encouraging growers to adopt natural farming methods, start dairy units and grow horticultural crops. The aim is to create multiple income streams beyond traditional crops. The guidance comes as part of a broader effort to raise farmer earnings.
why: Diversifying can protect farmers from market swings and improve livelihoods for young people in rural areas. Those interested should explore training programs and local support schemes.

headline: Anthropic AI claims breakthrough on Riemann hypothesis
hook: An AI says it may have solved the toughest math puzzle.
what: Anthropic's Claude AI announced a proof for the Riemann hypothesis, a century‑old problem in mathematics. Several independent mathematicians have said the proof looks highly plausible.
why: If confirmed, the result could reshape number theory and impact fields that rely on prime numbers, making it worth watching for students of math and tech.

headline: Blood test may forecast prostate cancer radiotherapy success
hook: A simple blood marker could tell which patients gain from SBRT.
what: Researchers found that circulating tumor DNA measured before stereotactic body radiotherapy correlates with faster disease progression in men with oligoprogressive castration‑resistant prostate cancer. The test may help select patients who will benefit most from the treatment.
why: Knowing who responds can avoid unnecessary side effects and focus care, so patients should ask their oncologist about ctDNA testing.

headline: Periyar Reserve rolls out plastic‑free Irumudikkettu in Sabarimala
hook: Say goodbye to plastic waste on pilgrim trips.
what: The Periyar Tiger Reserve has introduced an eco‑friendly version of the Irumudikkettu for pilgrims visiting Sabarimala. Earlier, the sacred bundles often contained items wrapped in plastic, creating litter inside the reserve. The new design aims to cut down that waste.
why: Less plastic means easier clean‑up and protects wildlife habitats, so young travelers can enjoy a greener pilgrimage. Consider using the new bundles if you’re heading to Sabarimala.

headline: Monsoon session still open after 100 days, no special sitting announced
hook: Parliament hasn't formally closed the session yet.
what: Both Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha were adjourned indefinitely on August 13. As of the morning of November 21, neither house has been formally prorogued.
why: The delay keeps the session technically active, influencing legislative timelines. Young Indians should stay alert for any upcoming announcements.

headline: Sarvam AI launches Token Factory, boosting India's AI infrastructure
hook: A new AI tool could power the apps you love.
what: Sarvam AI announced its Token Factory, a platform that adds a new layer to the country's AI infrastructure. The move expands the ecosystem for AI inference in India.
why: It could give developers more resources to build smarter apps and services. Keep an eye on emerging AI tools that may shape future tech jobs.

headline: Australia clinches first T20I win over England at MCG
hook: Nikhil Chaudhary’s all‑round heroics seal a nail‑biting finish.
what: Australia defeated England by three wickets in the opening men’s T20 International at the Melbourne Cricket Ground. All‑rounder Nikhil Chaudhary and fresh‑face Edwards starred, delivering the winning runs in the final over.
why: The close contest highlights the excitement of T20 cricket, encouraging young fans to follow upcoming series and support their favourite teams.

headline: Princess Kate shares cancer story in new doc 'Heal'
hook: Watch the royal’s candid journey on BBC and NBC.
what: Catherine, Princess of Wales, appears in the documentary 'Heal' where she talks about her battle with cancer. The film will premiere on BBC and later on NBC.
why: The documentary gives young viewers insight into coping with serious illness and highlights the value of support and awareness.

headline: ITAT rules seized cash counts as business income in ₹12 cr case
hook: Tax tribunal's decision could change how seized money is taxed.
what: The Income Tax Appellate Tribunal in Bangalore decided that cash seized by the tax department in a ₹12 crore case will be treated as business income. The ruling applies to the businessman involved in the case.
why: It sets a precedent for future tax seizures, affecting how young entrepreneurs may be taxed on seized assets. Stay aware of tax implications.

headline: Yogi Adityanath’s mother’s funeral held in Haridwar
hook: Prime Minister reaches out as the chief minister mourns his loss.
what: The final rites for the mother of Uttar Pradesh chief minister Yogi Adityanath were performed at Chandi Ghat in Haridwar. Several political leaders attended and paid their respects. Prime Minister Narendra Modi called Yogi to convey his condolences.
why: The ceremony shows the personal side of public leaders, reminding young Indians that politicians also face family tragedies. Staying aware of such events helps understand the human dimension of governance.

headline: Gandhinagar farmer loses 10.61 lakh in UPI hack
hook: A simple phone hack wiped out a farmer’s savings.
what: A farmer from Gandhinagar said his mobile was hacked, leading to unauthorized UPI transactions that totalled ₹10.61 lakh. The fraudsters used the phone’s payment apps to move the money.
why: It shows how vulnerable anyone using UPI can be if their phone isn’t secured. Young users should protect devices with strong passwords and enable two‑factor authentication.

headline: Kozhikode DIET launches Munnettu for tribal students
hook: A new scheme aims to close learning gaps for tribal kids.
what: Kozhikode DIET introduced the Munnettu programme targeting tribal students. Action plans are being prepared and carried out to raise the quality of their schooling and to get them involved in non‑academic activities.
why: Improving education for tribal youth can open better opportunities and support inclusive growth. Stay aware of such local initiatives and encourage participation.

headline: Teens eager for GTA 6, parents face a choice
hook: Your kid’s next game could be a family discussion.
what: Many teenagers are asking to play Grand Theft Auto 6. Parents are being asked to decide whether to allow it. A school organized a drawing contest to urge students not to miss classes for the game.
why: Understanding the debate helps families set clear rules about gaming time and school priorities.

headline: Fi Money trims FY26 loss by 25%, revenue falls 21%
hook: Fintech’s profit dip shows challenges for young investors.
what: Fintech startup Fi Money said its consolidated net loss for FY26 dropped 25%, now standing at ₹153.3 crore. At the same time, its revenue slipped by 21% compared with the prior period.
why: The slowdown highlights tougher conditions for digital finance firms, which could influence job prospects and investment choices for Gen Z. Keep an eye on fintech trends if you’re eyeing a career or investments in this space.

headline: Padmaja quits BJP, sparks fresh debate in Kerala politics
hook: A sudden exit revives old party tensions.
what: Padmaja resigned from the BJP, saying personal reasons. The party called her departure unfortunate. Thrissur MP Suresh Gopi said he was not part of her joining the BJP, and Congress leaders opposed any chance of her returning.
why: The move could shift political dynamics in Kerala, influencing young voters. Keep an eye on local political changes.

headline: GTA 6 rolls out new bike lineup, reviewers split on handling
hook: Your next virtual ride looks epic, but will it feel right?
what: Grand Theft Auto 6 includes a variety of motorcycles and bicycles, expanding the game’s vehicle roster. Reviewers say the designs are detailed, yet they disagree on how the bikes handle during play.
why: For gamers who love street racing or exploring open worlds, the new rides add immersion, but testing them in a demo or waiting for updates may be wise.

headline: IMD warns of heavy rain in five Kerala districts
hook: Sudden downpours expected in your city this weekend
what: The India Meteorological Department has issued a yellow alert for isolated heavy rainfall, forecasting 64.5 to 115.5 mm. The warning covers Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam, Pathanamthitta, Kottayam and Idukki for November 24‑25, 2026.
why: Students and commuters should follow updates and adjust travel plans, steering clear of flood‑prone areas.

headline: Haircare brand Traya posts 73% revenue rise to ₹585 cr
hook: Your favourite hair products just helped a startup hit half‑billion rupees.
what: Traya, a haircare startup backed by Fireside, reported revenue of ₹585 crore for FY26, a 73% increase from the previous year. Its net loss also grew by 23%.
why: The surge reflects strong demand for grooming items among Indian youth, while the higher loss shows the challenges of rapid scaling. Watch emerging brands for future job or investment chances.

headline: IRDAI to enable real‑time health claim tracking
hook: Instant updates on your medical claim could be coming soon.
what: The Insurance Regulator is set to introduce live tracking for health insurance claims, standardised settlement rules and clearer explanations for rejections. The move aims to make the process more transparent.
why: For Indian youth, faster, transparent payouts mean less hassle during emergencies; keep an eye on policy updates and check if your insurer adopts the new system.

headline: Union Minister Shah to discuss Siang Valley dam concerns
hook: Your voice could shape a massive river project
what: Union Home Minister Shah said he learned about the worries of people in Siang Valley over a dam project from media reports. He called the issues raised significant and promised to address them through dialogue.
why: Large infrastructure projects can affect local communities, so staying updated helps you share your view. Keep an eye on the story and discuss it with friends.

headline: Edamalakudy Tribal Panchayat Threatened With Closure, Says Opposition
hook: Kerala’s first tribal council may shut down over cash crunch.
what: Opposition leader Pinarayi Vijayan said Edamalakudy, the state’s inaugural tribal panchayat, is confronting a severe financial shortfall and unpaid staff wages. The situation could lead to its closure.
why: If the council closes, local tribal communities could lose essential services. Young people should stay informed and push for timely government action.

headline: 25‑Year Study Shows Best Mix for Stable Returns
hook: Looking for steady growth without crazy swings? See the winning combo.
what: A review of 25 years of equity, debt and gold data compared returns and volatility for various mixes. The analysis pinpointed which allocation delivered higher gains with lower risk.
why: Knowing the optimal blend helps young investors grow their savings while keeping losses in check. Teens can use this guide to start building a balanced portfolio early.

headline: Rijiju rebuts Gandhi's 'compromised PM' comment, raises 1962 war query
hook: Political spar sparks fresh debate on India's past wars and poverty
what: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi said the prime minister is compromised. BJP minister Kiren Rijiju answered, questioning the Congress on the 1962 war and poverty. The exchange prompted BJP figures to call Gandhi clueless about global geopolitics.
why: These exchanges shape the political narrative that influences policies on history and social issues. Staying aware helps young Indians understand how parties frame national debates.

headline: EPFO offers monthly pension option for retirees
hook: Your PF can now turn into a steady paycheck.
what: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation introduced a Systematic Withdrawal Plan that lets retirees keep their PF balance and receive a fixed monthly amount. The plan was discussed at the 240th meeting of the Central Board of Trustees chaired by Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya. Authorities are also looking at tax adjustments for the scheme.
why: Young workers should know this option exists for future retirement planning and may need to consider its tax implications later. Understanding the payout structure can help in long‑term financial decisions.

headline: Malayali Vlogger Dies on Everest Base Camp Trek
hook: A popular travel creator’s fatal trek raises safety concerns.
what: Travel vlogger Anjunath, who had completed the Annapurna Base Camp trek last year, died while attempting the Everest Base Camp trek in Nepal. Authorities suspect acute mountain sickness as the cause.
why: Young adventurers should understand altitude risks and prepare thoroughly before high‑altitude treks.

headline: Cyclone Akvan remnants to cause rain and winds in Bengal
hook: Expect sudden showers and breezy days across Bengal this weekend.
what: The India Meteorological Department says the leftover system of Cyclone Akvan will bring rain to Bengal until November 22. Thunderstorms with wind gusts of 30‑40 km/h are expected across most of South Bengal and parts of North Bengal on Saturday.
why: Students and commuters should carry umbrellas and plan travel accordingly, as sudden showers may affect outdoor activities and transport.

headline: Car crash on Yercaud ghat kills one, injures four
hook: A night drive turned tragic on Yercaud’s winding road.
what: Around 10:30 pm near Keeraikadu, a driver lost control on the Yercaud‑Kuppanur Ghat Road and the vehicle fell into a 100‑foot gorge. One passenger died and four others were injured.
why: The incident highlights safety risks on hilly highways; young drivers should stay cautious, especially at night.

headline: Gold down 32% since 2026 peak, recovery may take years
hook: A steep drop could mean a long wait for price bounce.
what: Gold prices have slipped almost 32% from their January 2026 high. Past corrections show it typically takes six to ten years for gold to climb back to earlier levels.
why: Young investors should expect a prolonged recovery and plan long‑term, rather than expecting quick gains.

headline: Silver Prices Plunge Over 60% Since January
hook: The metal that once shone is now cheap.
what: Silver’s market price has fallen more than 60% from its January high, according to the latest data on 21 November. Prices are listed per kilogram and per 100 grams for major Indian cities such as Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata.
why: A steep drop may affect anyone considering silver as an investment or a purchase, so young buyers should compare current rates before deciding.

headline: Logitech launches MX Master 4 Creator mouse in India
hook: A pro‑grade mouse now lands in Indian markets.
what: Logitech introduced a limited‑edition MX Master 4 Creator mouse for Indian buyers. It comes with programmable buttons, haptic feedback and a studio‑style look.
why: Students and young creators who need precise control for design or gaming can consider this new tool for smoother workflow.
